title: SPARE: Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy for Efficient MoEs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity efficiently, yet their substantial memory footprint poses a major barrier to deployment. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, but most methods focus on which experts to remove and prune every layer equally. We propose SPARE (Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy), a training-free, selector-agnostic method that decides how many experts to remove from each layer using routing entropy, the entropy of tokens' normalized Top-K gate weights on calibration data. When a token's gate weight is spread evenly, removing one active expert discards little of it, so SPARE prunes layers with more diffuse routing more aggressively. A perturbation bound under random pruning formalizes this intuition, and controlled interventions with a fixed selector link concentrated routing to larger output changes. With the same selector and budget, SPARE improves average accuracy over uniform allocation

translated_title: SPARE：通过路由熵进行稀疏度分配以实现高效的专家混合模型
translated_abstract: 混合专家架构能够高效地扩展模型容量，但其巨大的内存占用成为部署的主要障碍。专家剪枝可以减少内存占用，但大多数方法只关注删除哪些专家，并对每一层进行同等程度的剪枝。我们提出了SPARE（基于路由熵的稀疏度分配），这是一种无需训练、与选择器无关的方法，它利用路由熵——即token在校准数据上归一化Top-K门控权重的熵——来决定从每一层中删除多少个专家。当一个token的门控权重均匀分散时，删除一个活跃专家只会丢弃其中很小一部分信息，因此SPARE会更激进地剪枝那些路由更分散的层。随机剪枝下的扰动界限将这一直觉形式化，且使用固定选择器的受控干预实验表明集中路由与更大的输出变化相关联。在使用相同选择器和相同预算的情况下，SPARE相比均匀分配方式提升了平均准确率。
tldr: SPARE是一种无需训练的MoE专家剪枝方法，利用路由熵自适应地为各层分配不同的剪枝稀疏度，在相同预算下比均匀剪枝获得更高的模型准确率。
en_tdlr: SPARE is a training-free expert pruning method for MoEs that adaptively allocates layer-wise sparsity based on routing entropy, achieving higher accuracy than uniform pruning under the same budget.
